subject: Power outage — {{branchName}}
bodyText: At {{branchName}}, {{pcCount}} PCs went off at once around {{time}}. It looks like a power outage. Guests whose play was cut off got their time back automatically. If the outage lasted over 30 minutes, their sessions are paused — resume them in the Panel when the guest is back.
bodyHtml:
At {{branchName}}, {{pcCount}} PCs went off at once around {{time}}. It looks like a power outage.

Guests whose play was cut off got their time back automatically. If the outage lasted over 30 minutes, their sessions are paused — resume them in the Panel when the guest is back.
